structural_change: H-DIE-RLY 2026-10-16: native launch FAIL 288.1 ps (305 outputs) of CLOSED hbfd_rly_624_ns-v2-212c3439c. Measured root cause (NS routed STA, o[533]): the single relay flop sat at the INPUT face (io_flop_at_pins anchors i[] first), so DFFASRHQNx1/QN drove a 14 fF cross-tile wire (slew 147 ps, clk->QN 108 ps vs 62 ps at the pin) into INV + BUFx4f + HB4xp67 (68 ps) + BUF + port BUF; the HB4 output stage alone is ~130 ps of every launch (median 208-220 ps). Fix: anchor each flop at its output pin, output pad HB1xp67, input pad HB2xp67 (capture budget 190 has >= 25 ps room), hold margin 10 ps; RTL, outline, pin faces and port list unchanged; 0 cycles. nl2 (nl1 GRT-0116 at the output face, measured on 5_1_grt-failed.odb of ew-nl1: flop x 5.0, its QN INV GPL-placed at x 9.1 BEHIND the flop, ORFS output port BUFx2 at x 9.5 (port at x 0): every bit zig-zagged across the flop band, M4 overflow 1002 / M2 518 at x 6-11 on a 10.5 pins/um M2/M4 face): QN INV seeded FIRM at the pin with the stage (leaf_iohold OT_OUTHOLD_ABSORB_INV, opt-in), no ORFS port buffers (DONT_BUFFER_PORTS: the BUFx4f stage drives the pin), out pad HB2 to keep FF out-hold without the port BUF, flops behind the 3.4-um stage band at an explicit 4.3-um gap (15 columns) so each bit is a straight in-pad -> flop -> INV/BUF/HB2/BUF -> pin line.

reroute_reason.fix: flop anchored at its OUTPUT pin (was at the input face or free): DFFASRHQNx1 QN no longer drives a 10-20 um wire (108 ps clk->QN at 14 fF in NS o[533]); output stage INV(FIRM at pin)+BUF+HB2+BUF, no port BUF, instead of BUF+HB4+BUF (-50 ps TT); input HB2 pad; same RTL/outline/pin faces
